searches_tried: Local comps.py (pipeline and work) for box records, beatles, pink floyd, rolling stones, dark side, goats head soup, tommy who, status quo gold bars. Generic mixed box of common LPs so web search skipped; eBay sold would help only if a rare pressing shows. Gowans hammer for comparable boxes ranges $20-$310, median about $110 for boxes naming Floyd/Beatles. No AUD conversion needed.
viewing_check: Check the Beatles labels (Parlophone black/yellow mono vs later), the Dark Side label (SQ marking, solid triangle, posters/stickers) and rest of box for hidden rarities (Australian pressings, Zeppelin, Bowie, Dylan, jazz). Look at vinyl condition for scratches.
